name: Raw Kale Salad & Baked Kale Chips (Coarse Insoluble Cellulose Warning)
whyItWorks: Kale possesses tough, rigid cell walls reinforced with insoluble crystalline cellulose and thick fibrous ribs. Human enzymes cannot break raw kale down; it balls up into scratchy abrasive wads that scrape inflamed bowel lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Trigger Hazard: Completely avoid raw kale salads, massaged kale, and dried kale chips. If desiring greens, choose thoroughly wilted baby spinach or well-cooked zucchini.
watchOuts: One of the most abrasive raw roughage foods; causes sharp colonic pain and fecal urgency.
